decision: Reject pre-wrapper register thunk prototype; restore retained wrapper ABI
limitations: Prototype includes a separate branch thunk before the unchanged ordinary wrapper. Extra branch/subtraction and caller-side loads did not improve these actual workload timings.
No peer/parity win claimed; no native prototype publication.
Baseline and candidate ran three alternating pairs on shared benchmark lock, GOMAXPROCS=1; correct workload oracle and zero per-call allocations.
